newsitem.title: CHINA: Soccer - China league frontrunner Dalian unbeaten.
newsitem.headline: Soccer - China league frontrunner Dalian unbeaten.

text.p: League Leader Dalian Wanda drew with hosts Beijing Guoan on Sunday to retain its first place at the top of the China professional soccer league, the Xinhua news agency said.
Dalian Wanda was powering toward taking the final trophy in the 22-round tournament with an unmatched 40 points, leaving defending champions Shanghai Shenhua eight points behind in second place.
Shanghai Shenhua was upset 1-0 by Jinan Taishan when Fen Jianguo scored the winning goal in the 55th minute of the second half.
Sichuan Quanxing climbed to seventh place with a surprise 1-0 win over visitors Guangdong Hongyuan.
August First trounced hosts Guangzhou Apollo 2-1 to return to third place in the rankings.
